mark_mixed_dtype_conv: mark a convolution node for mixed dtype binary folding when its output is float32 and converts back to float16 or bfloat16
mark_mixed_dtype_allowed_convs: mark all convolution nodes in a graph module that can be binary folded with mixed precision constants
recover_original_precision_folded_convs: recover original float16 or bfloat16 precision on conv weights and biases after binary folding to float32
binary_folding_init: initialize binary folding patterns that fuse add sub mul div operations with convolution nodes
folded_op: fold a binary operation over a convolution node into the conv weights or bias for improved performance
